result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position because the caps are not mutual: Contractor receives the greater-of-12-month-fees/USD 1,000,000 cap, while Company's cap remains fees paid without the same lookback, payable-fees component, or USD 1,000,000 floor. It also does not implement the fallback mutual 12-month-fee cap. The mutual damages exclusion, uncapped Excluded Claims, and treatment of Company's payment obligations otherwise align with the preferred position. The changes are targeted and preserve unrelated intent, but drafting quality is reduced by the inconsistent cap structure and the uncorrected “COMPANYS'” error.
